column1: # English typos in context (gate split): context<TAB>typed<TAB>intended, as english-typos.tsv, every context non-empty.
# Top-1: the middle slot (what space commits) is the intended word; top-3: it is anywhere in the bar.
# Written for this repo, with no external data: the misspellings of english-typos.tsv put in natural chat
# contexts, guard rows where the context favours the frequent word (they wre -> were), and rows whose
# typed word is correct and must stay. Each misspelling is in this file or in english-typos-context.tune.tsv,
# never both. Intended words were checked against the bundled en.fst.
